decisions.decision: Treat slabbed cards as a manual-boundary workflow when automatic detection follows the label or inner card instead of the slab exterior.
decisions.rationale: The general detector should remain conservative rather than gain slab-specific heuristics during this phase.

decisions.decision: Allow an explicitly confirmed manual output quadrilateral to drive real-pixel framing analysis.
decisions.rationale: Manual geometry is operator-authoritative while still requiring deliberate confirmation and invalidation when geometry changes.

decisions.decision: A thin border below the 3% trial minimum may still be recentered when opposite sides are materially imbalanced.
decisions.rationale: Insufficient background prevents reaching the aesthetic target but does not make conservative recentering useless.

decisions.decision: Keep private sources immutable and fixtures outside Git; share the project-local image-processing crate between production and the workbench.
decisions.rationale: The experiment must exercise production transforms without duplicating logic or committing private media.
